Arena choosers with miniatures (Host a server, server settings, map cycle): a tall transparent frame with the arena's miniature on a darker square and its name, unfolding into a list with Official, Downloaded and User projects tabs under the filter - typing searches all of them at once - a column of miniatures on a darker background and a separator under every arena. Corpse explosions (the stamina-restoring ones) no longer push characters away from the corpse - they push them on where they are running, through the center; a character standing still isn't pushed. New damage_definition::impulse_along_sentience_velocity.

Default sun shadow strength 0.7 (was 0.35) - maps without their own strength get stronger sun shadows (menu among the built-in ones). Official maps and the tutorial keep their lights with brighten_lights now written in (the default became false).

--print-server-key handled right at the start of main like --version: only the key on stdout (whatever is logged while making it goes to stderr, with the file it came from), no logs, no startup. USER_DIR and KEYS_DIR resolved by get_user_dir and get_keys_dir (all_paths.h) shared with the normal start, so the printed key is always the one the dedicated server uses - also with --appdata-dir and under the AppImage's AppRun.

Fixed: unchecking Bots when hosting a server still spawned bots - with the default Progressive difficulty the bot override was ignored, including the zero quota of the unchecked box. An all-zero quota (Bots unchecked, "/bots 0") now wins over Progressive too.
Add personal favorites to the DM Creature Manager

Stream channels: PacketChannel is folded into StreamPacketChannel, and the channel manager takes them through IStreamPacketChannel (RequestTime, CloseTime, Close) - the base's only other subclass was the old UdpChannel; a developer's own channel plugs in through the interface, a new transport still through IStreamConnection; the manager's list and Tunnel.GetPacketChannels are typed by it, so the server's inactive close needs no cast; TestPacketChannel runs on TestStreamConnection, moved to the tests' Providers; behaviour unchanged

QUIC SNI filtering: a flow given up releases the packets it buffered - where the give-up replaced the flow's list before returning it, so a ClientHello whose SNI was not found in time lost its first datagrams, so its handshake waited for a retransmission

Domain filtering: the client closes its domain filtering service, which closes its QUIC SNI service - where nothing closed them, so after a client's close the flow cache's cleanup job fired every minute until the GC
